Q: How many courses in total are listed?
R: SELECT count(*) FROM Courses

R: SELECT count(*) FROM Courses

Q: How many departments offer any degree?
R: SELECT count(DISTINCT department_id) FROM Degree_Programs

R: SELECT count(DISTINCT department_id) FROM Degree_Programs

Q: What are the names and descriptions of all the sections?

Q: What are the names and descriptions for all the sections?

Q: What is the semester which most student registered in? Show both the name and the id.
R: SELECT T1.semester_name ,  T1.semester_id FROM Semesters AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.semester_id  =  T2.semester_id GROUP BY T1.semester_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: For each semester, what is the name and id of the one with the most students registered?
R: SELECT T1.semester_name ,  T1.semester_id FROM Semesters AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.semester_id  =  T2.semester_id GROUP BY T1.semester_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: Who are enrolled in 2 degree programs in one semester? List the first name, middle name and last name and the id.
R: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.middle_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.student_id FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  =  2

Q: What are the first, middle, and last names, along with the ids, of all students who enrolled in 2 degree programs in one semester?
R: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.middle_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.student_id FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  =  2

Q: Who is enrolled in a Bachelor degree program? List the first name, middle name, last name.
R: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T1.middle_name ,  T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id JOIN Degree_Programs AS T3 ON T2.degree_program_id  =  T3.degree_program_id WHERE T3.degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'

Q: What are the first, middle, and last names for everybody enrolled in a Bachelors program?
R: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T1.middle_name ,  T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id JOIN Degree_Programs AS T3 ON T2.degree_program_id  =  T3.degree_program_id WHERE T3.degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'

Q: Find the kind of program which most number of students are enrolled in?
R: SELECT T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_summary_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What is the degree summary name that has the most number of students enrolled?
R: SELECT T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_summary_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What are all the course names of the courses which ever have students enrolled in?
R: SELECT DISTINCT T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id

Q: What are the names of all courses that have some students enrolled?
R: SELECT DISTINCT T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id

Q: Which address holds the most number of students currently? List the address id and all lines.
R: SELECT T1.address_id ,  T1.line_1 ,  T1.line_2 FROM Addresses AS T1 JOIN Students AS T2 ON T1.address_id  =  T2.current_address_id GROUP BY T1.address_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What is the id, line 1, and line 2 of the address with the most students?
R: SELECT T1.address_id ,  T1.line_1 ,  T1.line_2 FROM Addresses AS T1 JOIN Students AS T2 ON T1.address_id  =  T2.current_address_id GROUP BY T1.address_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
